messages:
maya_engineer: filing an ADA accommodation for light sensitivity (photophobia). doc recommends lower-intensity lighting, screen filters, and ability to avoid fluorescent-lit meeting rooms. submitting intake now.

accom-bot: HR case created: HR-2026-410 — 'Light sensitivity accommodation'. Intake requested.

olivia_peopleops: thanks @maya_engineer. looping @steve_manager @priyanka_hr and facilities_ops to coordinate immediate options.

steve_manager: thanks for telling us, Maya. we can move you to a low-light corner or provide blackout screens and tinted filters. quick Q: you had a couple of missed deadlines last quarter  how will the accommodation interact with delivery timelines? just want to set expectations.

maya_engineer: hi Steve  my doctor says bright lights trigger migraines and cognitive slowdown. i'm not asking to avoid deadlines, just small adjustments (lighting, filters, meeting seat). i worry accommodations might be taken as excuse though.

priyanka_hr: @maya_engineer we treat medical info confidentially. please complete the intake form: https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-410 or request a private call. HR will draft an accommodation letter after intake.

darren_legal: quick reminder to managers: document options offered and the employee's preference. do not condition accommodations on performance. if there are performance concerns, handle those through standard coaching with documented objectives separate from medical records.

facilities_ops: tagging workspace  we can ship a screen hood, install dimmable lamp, and reserve a low-light focus room while we assess permanent moves. opening ticket FCL-2026-7800.

olivia_peopleops: next steps: 1) Maya completes intake or schedules call; 2) facilities ships temporary kit (hood + lamp) and assesses seating (FCL-2026-7800); 3) manager coordinates short-term deadline adjustments if needed; 4) HR drafts accommodation letter within 3 business days after intake. tracker updated HR-2026-410.

steve_manager: thanks everyone. Maya  will make sure deliverables are clear and I'll propose temporary timeline buffer of 3 business days on a couple items while adjustments are in place. that's meant as support, not punitive.

maya_engineer: appreciate that, Steve. i can work with a small buffer for the next sprint while tests on lighting happen. thank you all for being prompt.

priyanka_hr: please DM any medical docs rather than posting here. HR will keep performance conversations separate in manager notes. closing public thread once accommodation letter is signed in HR-2026-410.
